title: 두 그램
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop rock with a driving punk influence. Distorted electric guitars play power chords and palm-muted eighth notes. A clean electric guitar plays a melodic lead line in the intro. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a consistent eighth-note pulse. Drums feature a heavy snare on 2 and 4 with open hi-hats on the off-beats. Male vocals are delivered in a melodic, chest-voice style with layered harmonies in the chorus. Key of E Major. Tempo is 145 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar melody, driving drums, distorted rhythm guitar]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
잠든 문이 닫히는 소리가 들렸어
사무실 소음이 한꺼번에 끊겼거든
형광등 세계에서 한 발짝 나오니까 [bass guitar slides]

밤하늘이 처음 보는 것처럼 까맸어
목에 걸린 사원증이 묵직했거든
하루치 숨을 참고 있었잖아

[Chorus]
[distorted power chords, crash cymbals]
지금이야 지금 숨 쉬어
넥타이를 풀어 목이 살아나
